title: Keyboard Manager does not always work
author: manpergr

status.label: Waiting for current app-specific repro
status.detail: The report describes failures across Word, Outlook, desktop Excel, and Excel in Edge. The July 18 request for a current build, numbered steps, and engine-log results is unanswered.

next_action: Await the exact current mapping, target application, and requested engine-log result before selecting a fix path.

judgment.rationale: The report is too broad to isolate a code path: it names several Office/browser contexts but gives no specific mapping, exact failing sequence, or current-build result. The latest maintainer request asks for a current-version retest, numbered steps, and engine-log errors; no response followed.
evidence: The issue reports PowerToys 0.91.0 on Windows 10 build 19045, installed system-wide and running elevated.
The reporter says Keyboard Manager works in a Word document but not Outlook, and may work in desktop Excel but not an Excel document opened in Edge; it may also stop working over time.
The July 18, 2026 maintainer comment requests a 0.100.2-or-newer retest, numbered steps, and whether the Keyboard Manager Engine Logs directory contains errors. No later author response appears.

Related open issue #37083 has a specific Task Manager repro and elevation discussion, but it does not establish that the Outlook/Excel-in-Edge report has the same cause. Suggested issues #25590 and #26457 are closed older intermittent reports without a covering fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the exact current mapping, target application, and requested engine-log result; then compare the affected foreground process and integrity level before proposing a fix.
requested_evidence: Numbered steps with exact mapping and affected target app
Whether the Keyboard Manager Engine Logs directory contains errors

fix_assessment.rationale: No code-level change is supportable until a current-build failure is narrowed to a specific mapping and target process. The unanswered maintainer request is retained; this does not assert that the reported app-specific behavior is not a PowerToys defect.

issue_context.summary: The reporter says Keyboard Manager remaps work in some Office documents but not Outlook or Excel in Edge, and can stop working after a period of use.
known_information: The issue is open and labeled Issue-Bug for Keyboard Manager.
The report lists PowerToys 0.91.0 on Windows 10 build 19045, system install and elevated execution.
The report does not identify a specific shortcut mapping or numbered failing sequence.
A maintainer requested a current-build retest, numbered steps, and engine-log results on July 18, 2026; no response followed.
inferences: The difference between desktop Office and Excel in Edge could involve distinct foreground processes, app integrity levels, or application input behavior, but the report does not distinguish them.
Issue #37083 is related only at the broad app-specific symptom level; its Task Manager repro does not establish a duplicate or common fix.
issue_context.analysis: The report spans multiple target applications and an intermittent symptom without naming the affected mapping or a reproducible sequence. The existing request for a current version, concrete steps, and engine-log status is the smallest evidence needed before investigating foreground-process or injection behavior.
initial_investigation: Read the live issue body, labels, and both comments; the current-build request remains unanswered.
Read related issue #37083: it concerns specific Task Manager behavior and is not confirmed as the same failure.
Checked suggested issues #25590 and #26457; both are older closed intermittent reports and do not provide a current fix for this case.

information_gaps.information: A current 0.100.2-or-newer numbered repro naming the exact remap, target application, and whether the failure occurs in desktop Outlook/Excel or Excel in Edge; report whether the Keyboard Manager Engine Logs directory shows errors.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report combines several application contexts and intermittent failures, so the failing process and mechanism cannot be isolated.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest on 0.100.2 or newer, record the exact remap and target app, follow numbered steps, and check %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\PowerToys\Keyboard Manager\Engine\Logs\ for errors.
